Evan: Incoming visit Thurs 2:45pm - small solar panel mockups (2 boxes, ~25lb each). Courier 'ParcelPro'. Can we get 2 visitor badges and a short indoor staging spot?
Front Desk: Noted. Do boxes need climate-controlled space or just dry storage?
Evan: Dry storage is fine. They'll want a plug to top up one monitor battery.
Priya: I'll bring a power strip. Also can someone print 2 matte badges and put them at the desk?
Front Desk: Will print matte badges. Please provide guest names for check-in.
Evan: Guests: Dr. Hana Lee and Amir Qureshi. They'll need WiFi OTP and visitor form link.
Facilities: Staging reserved: Staging B (near north entrance) until 18:00. Rolling cart available.
security-bot: Reminder: all external boxes must be logged and scanned. Please label crate with parcel ID PP-4492.
Zoe: I'll meet the courier at 14:30 to help with carry-in. Can someone also grab a small table for setup?
Priya: Table + two chairs confirmed. Also quick poll: bottled water :droplet: or sparkling :sparkles:?
Evan: :droplet:
Front Desk: Bottled water stocked. Badges queued and OTP generated. See you Thursday!
